Coconut & Jam On Bread

A simple tiffin with a jammy twist! Will your kids enjoy this treat?

5 minPreparation
10 minCooking
1Servings

Ingredients

For 1 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Heat the butter in a pan; add the coconut and fry for a few seconds.
  2. Add the milk and bring to a boil.
  3. Add the breadcrumbs, cashew nut powder, Kissan Pineapple Jam and cook, stirring, till the mixture is thick. Remove from heat and set aside to cool.
  4. Spread the topping on the bread and decorate with dollops of jam.
  5. One bite of Kissan Coconut and Jam on Bread and you will be whisked off to a tropical island.
